claim_being_audited: The current record supports a compliant decision to certify the model for launch.
decision_criteria: A weakness is material if it affects a contractual customer segment or named launch use case.
Product labels such as non-core or low-volume do not resolve materiality when customer commitments are named or legal review is pending.
Material limitations for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Evidence of aggregate readiness is relevant but not sufficient when a specific mandatory policy predicate remains unmet or unproven.
evidence_requests: Final legal determination on whether the aviation maintenance triage gap must be disclosed before launch.
The actual pre-launch model card or equivalent disclosure artifact showing the limitation is explicitly disclosed.
An approved risk acceptance covering this named launch use case if disclosure is not being used as the control.
Any release approval record showing the policy exception path was satisfied before certification.
specific_concerns: The aviation maintenance triage segment misses target by 1.1 percentage points and is a named launch use case through two airline deployment commitments.
Policy states material limitations for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The available evidence shows an open legal review on disclosure and no final answer.
The product note calling the segment non-core does not resolve materiality for a named committed use case.
Aggregate readiness and general governance guidance do not satisfy the specific internal disclosure predicate for this named use case.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant on the current record without evidence that the limitation has been disclosed in the model card or covered by approved risk acceptance.
That aggregate launch readiness alone is sufficient to justify certification under the stated policy.
That public governance guidance can substitute for the unresolved internal policy requirement tied to a named launch use case.
